levels.name: Observe
levels.text: Reads results every morning and writes findings. Proposes nothing.

levels.name: Propose
levels.text: Drafts test plans, creative and change sets for you to approve. Nothing reaches the account; you apply approved changes yourself in Ads Manager.

levels.name: Apply after approval
levels.text: The Operator writes exactly what you approved, nothing else. New ads are always created paused; you turn them on in Ads Manager.

sandbox.blurb: A synthetic fitness app, Pallas Fit, with a week of results already in.
